negative_findings: Exact symbolic two-witness control tied every forecast: no evidence the numerical recipient outperforms a fully informed symbolic learner.
Robust conventional rolling-three median control also tied every forecast at the same witnesses.
Nonrobust rolling-two OLS suffered 191/1536 errors due the deliberate spurious witness (expected comparator sensitivity, not a scientific superiority claim).
All true worlds are of the supplied gain-times-ideal-heat family; 48/48 nonlinear OFF queries were abstained from rather than solved.
No natural-language automatic extraction, external donor model weights, real-world causal physics, unknown-law transfer, online native Yggdrasil integration or independent first-use was tested.
interpretation: Evidence-grounded numeric coefficient correction, source-specific abstention, cold retention and context isolation are technically reproducible, but the strongest equal-information control is tied; no intelligence gain.
